messages.author: 0132905a867cf8fb
messages.subject: error bars
parts:
hei ,

i just have have calculated a mean of 1000 replications and standard
error of the 1000 replications. now i want to plot the mean with
geom_line ( time series plots ) showing an error bar on the lines. i
don't know how to do it with the stat_summary() in ggplot2.

i read from hadley's answer for one question in this group we can
use the stat_summary like

stat_summary(y = mean, ymin = min, ymax = max, geom = "errorbar")

but i have already the the mean and standard error that i calculated
them from the 1000 replications. i want to show on the line

ymax=mean+se
ymin=mean-se
interval=ymax < mean < ymin

any help please

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: error bars
parts:
Hi nameless,

You can close to answering your own question ;-)

ggplot(your_data, aes(x = Time, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean
+ SE)) + geom_errorbar() + geom_point()

Best regards,

Thierry
